label: ScreenBeam (Actiontec) ECB6200 Bonded MoCA 2.0 adapter
description: Bonded MoCA 2.0 Ethernet-over-coax adapter: up to 1.0 Gbps throughput over existing coax, backward compatible with MoCA 2.0/1.1/1.0, up to 16 nodes. One 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 port and one coax (F-type) port; sold today under the ScreenBeam brand, originally Actiontec ECB6200.
